# `github_projects`

Signs `gh` in to GitHub on the VM - from a token, or by the device flow - makes it git's credential helper, and clones your repositories into the projects directory. Three entry points: `main` for `just deploy --only configure` (`--tags github_projects`), `login` for `just login --only github` and the sign-in in `just deploy`, and `release` for `just destroy`.

Using it: [GitHub](../../guides/github.md). How it works: [§5.6](../../architecture/roles.md#56-github_projects--sign-in-to-github-clone-an-accounts-repositories).

## Entry point `main`

**Clone every GitHub repository of a user**

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `github_projects_user` | str | `dev` | Local user that owns the checkouts. Set through `vm_user` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_username` | str | `""` | **Required.** GitHub account to list repositories for. Set through `vault_github_username` in vault.yml. |
| `github_projects_token` | str | `""` | Lists private repositories and, with github_projects_auth, signs gh in on the VM where gh is signed out or signed in by this role. A login made by hand stays, and the token then only lists. A secret: never logged. Set through `vault_github_token` in vault.yml. |
| `github_projects_api_url` | str | `https://api.github.com` | Base URL of the GitHub REST API that lists the repositories and, for ssh clones, GitHub's host keys. Tests point it at a stand-in. |
| `github_projects_home` | path | `""` | Home directory of github_projects_user. Empty looks it up on the VM. |
| `github_projects_dir` | path | `""` | Destination directory. Defaults to ~/projects. Set through `vm_projects_dir` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_include_forks` | bool | `false` | Also clone repositories that are forks. |
| `github_projects_include_archived` | bool | `false` | Also clone archived repositories. |
| `github_projects_include` | list of `str` | `[]` | Repository names to clone. Empty means every repository of the user. Set through `github_projects` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_exclude` | list of `str` | `[]` | Repository names never cloned, even when github_projects_include names them. |
| `github_projects_vm_repos` | dict | `{}` | This VM's own list of repositories, when it has one - own (true) and names - in place of github_projects_include. A fork or an archived repository named on it is cloned. Published with the VM from its notes in Proxmox (just deploy --repos), never read from the VM. |
| `github_projects_clone_protocol` | str | `https` | https clones private repositories through gh; ssh needs a key of the user's own on the VM, and trusts GitHub's published host keys. One of `https`, `ssh`. |
| `github_projects_update_existing` | bool | `false` | Pull checkouts that already exist on every run. Off, a re-run never disturbs local work. |
| `github_projects_depth` | str | `""` | Shallow clone depth. Empty clones the full history. |
| `github_projects_clone_jobs` | int | `8` | How many repositories are cloned at once, each into a partial folder renamed into place once whole. 1 clones them one at a time. |
| `github_projects_auth` | bool | `true` | Sign gh in (from the token, or by a device-flow login the user makes once) and make it git's credential helper. Set through `github_auth` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_auth_method` | str | `auto` | auto takes the token when set, else the device flow; web is the device flow always; token is the token only, put over any login gh holds. One of `auto`, `web`, `token`. Set through `github_auth_method` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_login_scopes` | list of `str` | `[workflow]` | Scopes the device flow asks for on top of gh's own (repo, read:org, gist). Set through `github_login_scopes` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_login_desktop` | bool | `true` | During the device flow, open the page and copy the code on the controller. Off in every test. Set through `login_desktop` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_sign_in_follows` | bool | `false` | The sign-ins come next in this run (just deploy), so the message for a signed-out VM says so rather than naming just login --only github. |
| `github_projects_git_user_name` | str | `""` | git user.name for github_projects_user, written always. Empty derives it from the GitHub account, and only where ~/.gitconfig has none yet. Set through `git_user_name` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_git_user_email` | str | `""` | git user.email for github_projects_user, written always. Empty uses GitHub's noreply address for the account, and only where ~/.gitconfig has none yet. Set through `git_user_email` in local.yml. |
| `github_projects_host_flag` | str | `""` | What ends each just line naming this VM, in NEXT STEPS, a retry or a message - " --host &lt;name&gt;" where the checkout has more than one Proxmox host (claude_host_flag), so a line pasted later reaches the VM's host. Empty with one host. |

## Entry point `login`

**Say whether gh is signed in to GitHub, and how, and sign it in by the device flow when asked**

Reads gh's login state on the VM and prints it, with the one command to run when it is signed out. With github_projects_login_interactive, or the answer to the question github_projects_login_ask puts, signs a signed-out VM in by GitHub's device flow; playbooks/github_login.yml then runs the whole role.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `github_projects_login_interactive` | bool | `false` | Run the device flow for a signed-out VM. Set by playbooks/github_login.yml when names were given, and by just deploy for a VM whose Claude code was entered in the same run. |
| `github_projects_login_ask` | bool | `false` | Ask at a prompt first. just deploy sets it for every VM but one whose Claude prompt got Enter. For a VM with github_projects_login_interactive, Enter runs the device flow and "n" skips it; for any other, "y" runs it and Enter skips it. With no terminal the answer would be nothing, which is Enter, so playbooks/github_login.yml never sets it in a run without one. |
| `github_projects_login_role_follows` | bool | `false` | The whole role runs for this VM next, in the same run, so a vault token gh is not yet signed in with is said to be signed in by it rather than by a command to run. |
| `github_projects_host_flag` | str | `""` | What ends each just line for this VM, as main has it. |

## Entry point `release`

**Sign gh out before the VM is destroyed**

Signs gh out, and records what became of the login in github_projects_release_said, for destroy's report. No token is revoked at GitHub - revoking one gh sign-in there ends every gh sign-in of the account - so the report says where to revoke it, and what that does.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `github_projects_token` | str | `""` | The vault token, only to say that a login with it is every VM's. A secret: never logged. Set through `vault_github_token` in vault.yml. |

Also takes, as described under `main`: `github_projects_user`, `github_projects_home`.

These are not settings: Ansible ranks a role's vars above `local.yml`, so a value set there has no effect. 66 of the 73 are computed during a run, from earlier tasks' results. Each one's purpose is the first sentence of the comment above it, where it has one of its own.

| `github_projects_release_unrevoked` | Whether the summary says the token stays valid until the user revokes it - any but the vault's, which is every VM's: something left to do, for destroy's NEXT STEPS. | <code>{{ github_projects_stored_token &#124; length > 0 and (github_projects_release_ours &#124; bool or not (github_projects_token &#124; length > 0 and github_projects_stored_token == github_projects_token)) }}</code> |
| `github_projects_release_summary` | One clause for destroy's report on the VM; empty where gh held no login. | <code>{{ '' if github_projects_stored_token &#124; length == 0 else (github_projects_release_signed_out ~ '; the token this project signed it in with stays valid until revoked at' ~ ' https://github.com/settings/applications, under GitHub CLI - which signs out every gh you have, so' ~ ' destroy does not') if github_projects_release_ours &#124; bool else (github_projects_release_signed_out ~ " (vault_github_token is every VM's, so it is not revoked)") if github_projects_token &#124; length > 0 and github_projects_stored_token == github_projects_token else (github_projects_release_signed_out ~ '; its token is not one this project recorded making (a sign-in by' ~ ' hand, or one before this version), and stays valid until revoked - at https://github.com/settings/tokens' ~ ' if it is a personal access token, or under GitHub CLI at https://github.com/settings/applications,' ~ ' which signs out every gh you have') }}</code> |
| `github_projects_login_lacks_workflow` | Whether gh's login is a device-flow one without the workflow scope, which GitHub refuses a push that changes .github/workflows/ for: said by login_report.yml, with the gh auth refresh that adds it, and left to do. | <code>{{ github_projects_login_kind == 'oauth' and 'workflow' not in (github_projects_auth_account.scopes &#124; default('')) }}</code> |
| `github_projects_login_report` | What login_report.yml says of gh's login, and whether it is something left to do, which NEXT STEPS records and just status says: the core's words (lib/claude_vm/status/lines.py), one definition for both, from what the registers hold. | <code>{{ {'gh_found': github_projects_gh_found &#124; bool, 'status_rc': github_projects_auth_status.rc &#124; default(0), 'status_said': github_projects_status_said, 'signed_in': github_projects_signed_in &#124; bool, 'login_done': github_projects_login_done &#124; default(false) &#124; bool, 'account': github_projects_auth_account.login &#124; default('', true), 'kind': github_projects_login_kind, 'is_ours': github_projects_login_is_ours &#124; bool, 'lacks_workflow': github_projects_login_lacks_workflow &#124; bool, 'user': github_projects_user, 'host': ansible_host &#124; default(inventory_hostname), 'auth': github_projects_auth &#124; bool, 'auth_method': github_projects_auth_method, 'token_wanted': github_projects_token_wanted &#124; bool, 'token_set': github_projects_token_set &#124; bool, 'role_follows': github_projects_login_role_follows &#124; bool, 'configure_command': github_projects_configure_command, 'login_command': github_projects_login_command} &#124; github_login_report }}</code> |
| `github_projects_login_left` |  | `{{ github_projects_login_report.left }}` |

|---|---|---|

| Show the code, wait for the approval, and clean up whatever happened | block |  |
| &emsp;Wait for gh to show the code | `ansible.builtin.wait_for` |  |
| &emsp;Read what gh printed | `ansible.builtin.slurp` |  |

| &emsp;Say the code and the page | `ansible.builtin.debug` |  |
| &emsp;Look for a browser opener and a clipboard on this machine | `ansible.builtin.command` | <code>github_projects_login_desktop &#124; bool</code> |
| &emsp;Open the page in your browser | `ansible.builtin.command` | <code>github_projects_login_desktop &#124; bool and github_projects_login_opener &#124; length > 0</code> |
| &emsp;Copy the code to your clipboard | `ansible.builtin.command` | <code>github_projects_login_desktop &#124; bool and github_projects_login_found &#124; intersect(['pbcopy', 'wl-copy', 'xclip']) &#124; length > 0</code> |
| &emsp;Wait for the approval | `ansible.builtin.wait_for` |  |
| &emsp;*always:* | | |
| &emsp;&emsp;Give gh a moment to finish | `ansible.builtin.async_status` |  |
| &emsp;&emsp;End gh if it still runs | `ansible.builtin.command` | <code>github_projects_login_finished.finished &#124; default(0) &#124; int != 1</code> |
| &emsp;&emsp;Collect gh's result | `ansible.builtin.async_status` |  |
| &emsp;&emsp;Clean up gh's job | `ansible.builtin.async_status` |  |
| &emsp;&emsp;Read what gh printed, now it has finished | `ansible.builtin.slurp` |  |
| &emsp;&emsp;Remove gh's files | `ansible.builtin.file` |  |
| Read gh's login state again | `ansible.builtin.include_tasks` |  |
| Fail when the code was not approved | `ansible.builtin.fail` | <code>not github_projects_signed_in &#124; bool</code> |

| Remember the token this sign-in made for the VM | `ansible.builtin.copy` |  |
